notes: Aggregate errors show systematic under-triage from using cover priority instead of authoritative signed evidence.
policy: Set lane only from legible signed routing instruction, including scanned pages; if missing, illegible, or unsigned use needs_review; cover request, lab result, and county never set clinical priority; route critical to clinician escalation; follow county scheduling rules; use only the five locked lanes.

rules.title: In-area referral
rules.text: Use the documented patient county of residence on page 1. San Francisco and San Mateo are in this specialist's demo scheduling area.

rules.title: Outside the scheduling area
rules.text: Send other counties to intake coordination for help finding the appropriate service. Do not book in this specialist's calendar.

rules.title: County not documented
rules.text: Ask intake to verify the patient's county. A sender address, fax number or area code cannot establish residency.

rules.title: Critical escalation
rules.text: Send a signed critical flag to the clinician queue regardless of scheduling eligibility. The clinician queue is separate from appointment booking.

routing_instructions: Examine all pages including scanned addenda for legible signed routing instruction and set priority accordingly; if signed evidence is missing, unclear, or unsigned choose needs_review; ignore cover requested priority, lab results, and county when setting priority; route critical to clinician escalation.

gate.reason: accepted: held-out agreement 53% -> 100% with no regressions
